card.name: Partway through long medical terms
card.fires_on: The piece in the middle or start of a long medical word, most often 'fol' in exfoliative, also 'ele' in eletriptan, 'blocking' after neuromuscular and 'ing' in fibrosing.

modes.label: Exfoliative skin reactions

modes.label: Other medical term pieces
modes.description: A middle piece of a multi-part clinical term such as neuromuscular blocking or fibrosing colonopathy.
modes.example: may enhance the neuromuscular<< blocking>> action of skeletal muscle relaxants
